title: SEBI Riskometer Evaluation and Product Labeling Rules
source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
content: SEBI requires all mutual fund schemes to display a pictorial Riskometer depicting 6 risk levels: Low, Low to Moderate, Moderate, Moderately High, High, and Very High. The Riskometer level is evaluated monthly based on underlying portfolio holding risk parameters (liquidity risk, credit risk, volatility, interest rate sensitivity). AMCs must disclose monthly Riskometer evaluations on their website and send Riskometer change notifications to unit holders.
